title: University of Illinois Chicago College of Medicine systems impacted by ransomware attack
summary: The University of Illinois Chicago (UIC) recently experienced a ransomware attack that disrupted access to certain systems within its College of Medicine, leading to a temporary data theft and system outage.
why_it_matters: Ransomware operations combine disruption with extortion, making recovery speed and data-resilience core business risks.
recommendation: Verify offline backups, test restores, harden remote access, and review segmentation to limit lateral movement.
